title: Interlub Grease Recommender
summary: A student-built industrial grease recommendation system for the Interlub company, combining TF-IDF similarity, linear regression, K-Means clustering and factorial analysis to recommend and predict lubricant properties. A course script (Scripts/clase_datos_sinteticos.py) uses SDV's CTGANSynthesizer with an sdv.metadata.Metadata object, alongside the standalone copulas library, to generate a synthetic 1200-record grease dataset used to expand the training data.
